reviewCadence: At every login, MFA, bot guard, proof-of-work, rate-limit, exposed-credential, risk scoring, session, or authentication telemetry change.

requirements.name: Use multi-factor authentication
requirements.owasp: MFA is the strongest practical defense against credential stuffing and password spraying.

controls.name: Risk-triggered MFA challenge
controls.description: Password login requires MFA when the combined risk and credential-stuffing score reaches the configured step-up threshold.

requirements.name: Detect credential stuffing and password spraying patterns
requirements.owasp: Track large login volume from an IP/subnet and attempts against many accounts or from many sources.

controls.name: Redis correlation windows
controls.description: Failed logins update short and long Redis windows for IP-to-accounts and account-to-source relationships.

requirements.name: Apply graduated mitigation
requirements.owasp: Responses should combine observation, step-up, CAPTCHA/friction, and temporary blocking instead of relying on IP blocking alone.

controls.name: Step-up and block decisions
controls.description: Credential stuffing signals add MFA risk for valid credentials and block/tarpit attack traffic when multiple signals stack.

requirements.name: Limit authentication attempts across dimensions
requirements.owasp: Use layered limits for accounts, IPs, tenants, short bursts, and longer attack windows.

controls.name: IP, account, tenant, and correlation throttles
controls.description: Login checks pairwise IP/account limits, tenant limits, and credential stuffing correlation windows.

requirements.name: Require browser friction for login
requirements.owasp: Multi-step login, JavaScript challenges, headless-browser detection, CAPTCHA alternatives, and degradation slow automation.

controls.name: Multi-step login with PoW and bot signals
controls.description: Identifier challenge requires one-time PoW, bot guard proof/signals, decoy handling, and HTTP signal scoring before password entry.

requirements.name: Identify leaked credentials
requirements.owasp: Check passwords and username/password pairs against known breach data where possible.

controls.name: Trusted exposed credential screening
controls.description: Registration rejects exposed passwords and login rejects compromised-password signals from trusted proxy headers.

requirements.name: Record metrics and security events
requirements.owasp: Defenses should emit detected and mitigated attack volume metrics and security telemetry.

controls.name: Risk and bot telemetry
controls.description: Credential stuffing decisions produce risk events, bot decision metrics, and suspicious-login metadata without logging passwords.

requirements.name: Prevent regressions
requirements.owasp: Credential stuffing controls must remain enforced as authentication code evolves.

controls.name: Credential stuffing prevention gate
controls.description: The root check path validates OWASP evidence, correlation logic, MFA step-up, bot friction, throttling, leaked credential screening, and telemetry.
